title: 第15章 巨灵剑法第16章 田氏截杀
lines: 所谓功、法，其实是两种不同的概念。
功，乃是修炼的基础方法，它是修士踏上修行之路的引路灯塔。
具体来说，就是指引修士如何与天地间那浩瀚无尽的灵气产生共鸣，并将其引入体内，从而不断拓宽自身丹田气海，实现修为境界节节攀升的法门。
就拿紫阳宗的《紫阳功》来说，这门功法的特点是不分属性，以其独特的运转灵气的方法，将引入体内的各种灵力，融合为修士自身属性的灵气，适合绝大多数修士修炼。
而法，则有所不同。
它提升的并非是修士修为，而是修士运用灵气的法门，多是提升修士的战斗能力的。诸如诸多的身法、剑法刀法等等，当然也会有一些炼丹法、炼器法等。
这些法大多是成系统的。
当然，修仙界还有很多小型的法术，大多功能简单，但是使用得当的话，能发挥出意想不到的效果。
如火球术、水龙术以及土盾术等。
不过目前修士们普遍将功称为功法，而将法与术并称为法术。
李卓阳修炼的功法其实是紫阳宗烂大街的《小紫阳功》，这个功法是正经《紫阳功》的删减版，不仅只能修炼至炼气境圆满，而且还没有附带任何法术。
而他已经学会的火球术、水龙水、土盾术等法术，更是烂大街的入门法术，几乎是个修士都会。
李卓阳想找到一本至少可以修炼到筑基境的功法，然而逛遍整个一楼，并未发现他想要的。
因为这里都是一些只能修炼到炼气境的功法，想来是紫阳宗刻意为之。
“敢问赵师兄，藏经楼是否有可修炼至筑基境的功法？”
李卓阳见久寻不到，便找赵管事询问道。
“师弟志向不低啊，筑基境的功法当然有，只不过都在二楼，而且至少需要数千功德点方可兑换。”
李卓阳听后也不觉气馁，这也符合他的猜测，于是他转而问道：“那可有在下能兑换的，刀法、剑法或步法？”
“有当然是有，不过这些法术可着实不便宜，比如这本《烈焰刀》，是火属性同门的最爱，不过却需要八百功德点。”
“这本《迷踪步》，乃炼气境中速度最快的身法，需要一千功德点。”
“这本《木灵鞭法》，一旦修成，既能困敌又能护身，只需六百功德点，堪称最具性价比之法术。”
这赵师兄说起珍藏的法术，立刻滔滔不绝，但是他所介绍的都是李卓阳眼下兑换不了的。
“额……师兄，可有五百功德点以下的法术？”
“五百？”赵师兄听了一顿，下意识就想摇头，不过又好像想起了什么，忽然跑向一个角落道：“稍等一下，好像还真有！”
过了片刻，赵师兄举着一本泛黄的小册子走了过来。
“还真让我找到了，这本《巨灵剑法》，原本是比《迷踪步》还要珍贵的法术，但是已有百年未有人兑换了，长老前些日子方把价格降到四百功德点。”
“百年未有人兑换？师兄可知为何？”
“实不相瞒，这剑法威力绝对是一楼所有法术中攻击力最强的，但是对体能及法力的消耗同样也是最快的。”
“据说，这本功法是改自上古一本炼体修士的剑法，故而对肉身及法力浑厚程度要求极高，向师弟这样炼气四层的修士，恐怕连一剑都施展不了。”
赵师兄倒像个厚道之人，说完还摇摇头，准备将这本剑法放回原处。
“这本剑法我要了！”
李卓阳却大喜过望，炼体修士的剑法，那岂不是正合我意？
不过那赵师兄却像是遇到了不听话的孩子一般劝说道：
“这位师弟，我观你似乎跟我一样，都不是什么资质很好的人。”
“其实像我们这样的人，其实修炼什么法术的意义并不是很大，好一些的法术固然威力大，但是对资质要求也极高，我们往往发挥不出其真正威力。”
content_en:
The so-called gong and dharma are actually two different concepts.
Gong is the basic method of cultivation, and it is the guiding beacon for monks to embark on the road of cultivation.
Specifically, it is a method that guides monks on how to resonate with the vast and endless spiritual energy between heaven and earth and introduce it into the body, so as to continuously expand the sea of ​​Qi in their Dantian and realize the continuous improvement of their cultivation realm.
Take Ziyang Sect's "Purple Yang Gong" as an example. The characteristic of this technique is that it does not distinguish between attributes. With its unique method of moving spiritual energy, it will integrate various spiritual powers introduced into the body into the spiritual energy of the monk's own attributes. It is suitable for most monks to practice.
The law, however, is different.
What it improves is not the monk's cultivation, but the monk's method of using spiritual energy. It mostly improves the monk's combat ability. Such as many body skills, sword skills, sword skills, etc., of course there will also be some alchemy methods, weapon refining methods, etc.
Most of these laws are systematic.
Of course, there are many small spells in the world of immortality. Most of them have simple functions, but if used properly, they can produce unexpected effects.
Such as fireball, water dragon and earth shield.
However, currently monks generally refer to gong as gongfa, and both methods and techniques are called spells.
The technique that Li Zhuoyang practices is actually the "Little Ziyang Kung" of the Ziyang Sect. This technique is an abridged version of the serious "Ziyang Kung". Not only can it only be practiced to the perfection of the Qi Refining Realm, but it also does not come with any magic spells.
And the fireball, water dragon, and earth shield spells he has learned are entry-level spells that almost every monk can master.
Li Zhuoyang wanted to find a book that could help him practice at least the foundation-building level. However, he searched the entire first floor and didn't find what he wanted.
Because here are some techniques that can only be practiced to the Qi Refining Realm. It seems that Ziyang Sect did this deliberately.
"I dare to ask Senior Brother Zhao, does the Sutra Library have any techniques that can be cultivated to the foundation-building level?"
When Li Zhuoyang couldn't find it for a long time, he asked Manager Zhao about it.
"Junior brother, your ambitions are not low. Of course there are foundation-building techniques, but they are all on the second floor, and you need at least several thousand merit points to redeem them."
Li Zhuoyang didn't feel discouraged after hearing this, which was in line with his guess, so he turned to ask: "Is there anything I can exchange for it, sword skills, sword skills or footwork?"
"Of course there are, but these spells are really not cheap. For example, this "Flame Knife" is a favorite among fire attribute students, but it requires 800 merit points."
"This "Mizongbu" is the fastest movement technique in the Qi Refining Realm and requires one thousand merit points."
"This "Wood Spirit Whip Technique", once mastered, can trap enemies and protect yourself. It only requires 600 merit points. It can be called the most cost-effective method."
Senior Brother Zhao talked about the treasured spells and immediately talked endlessly, but what he introduced was something that Li Zhuoyang could not redeem at the moment.
"Um...senior brother, do you have any spells with less than 500 merit points?"
"Five hundred?" After hearing this, Senior Brother Zhao subconsciously wanted to shake his head, but then he seemed to think of something and suddenly ran to a corner and said, "Wait a minute, it seems like there really is one!"
After a while, Senior Brother Zhao came over holding a yellowed booklet.
"I really found it. This "Giant Sword Technique" was originally a more precious spell than "The Lost Steps", but no one has redeemed it for a hundred years. The elder just lowered the price to 400 merit points a few days ago."
"No one has redeemed it for a hundred years? Senior brother, do you know why?"
"To be honest, this sword technique is definitely the most powerful among all the spells on the first floor, but it also consumes the most physical energy and mana the fastest."
"It is said that this technique is adapted from an ancient sword technique used by body-refining monks. Therefore, it requires extremely high levels of physical body and magical power. A monk at the fourth level of Qi-refining like Junior Brother may not even be able to use a sword."
Senior Brother Zhao seemed like a kind person. After speaking, he shook his head and prepared to put the sword technique back to its original place.
"I want this swordsmanship book!"
Li Zhuoyang was overjoyed. Isn't the swordsmanship of the body-refining monk exactly what I want?
However, Senior Brother Zhao persuaded him as if he had encountered a disobedient child:
"Junior brother, it seems to me that you are not a very qualified person like me."
"Actually, for people like us, it doesn't really mean what spells we practice. Although better spells are powerful, they also require extremely high qualifications, and we often cannot exert their true power."
